overview: The MPS School Committee received updates on proposed elementary math curriculum, 2022 summer programming, and the superintendent's district listening tour. The committee also approved consent agenda items and subcommittee minutes.

items.title: Good of the Order
items.summary: Member Kreatz commended the committee and administrative staff for finalizing the committee's policy rules.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: The committee approved the bills and payroll following a clarification regarding a confidential settlement line item, and approved the meeting minutes from March 21, 2022.

items.title: Rules and Policy Subcommittee Report
items.summary: Approved the March 30, 2022 subcommittee minutes following an update on ongoing work regarding school attorney and district dress code policies.

items.title: Superintendent's Comments and Updates
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent announced upcoming district events, middle school lottery details, student accolades, and seasonal recognitions.

items.title: Elementary Math Program Adoption Recommendation
items.summary: Math Director Faiza Khan presented the recommendation to adopt Investigations 3 for elementary math, though no formal vote was taken after member comments noted curriculum selection falls outside school committee authority.

items.title: Overview of Summer Programming Opportunities
items.summary: District administrators presented the menu of 2022 summer offerings, covering Summer Fun, extended school year services, English learner programs, Camp Mustang 2.0, and academic acceleration camps.

items.title: Superintendent's Listening Tour Report
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent presented key findings from her March meetings with 101 educators and 20 administrators, highlighting feedback on professional development, social-emotional learning, and staffing.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: The committee expressed condolences to the families of former school committee member Carol Sharpton, John C. McKaylee, Fred Tower, and James A. Cheyney Jr.
